name: Font of Truth
body:
Type curse; Save Will DC 15 negates, Will DC 15 to avoid effects; Frequency 1/minute (when speaking only)

Effect

The target is unable to intentionally lie. In addition, anytime the target is asked a question, she must succeed at a Will save or answer in exacting, truthful detail. The target receives an additional save once per minute to cease elaborating upon her answer.
